limitations.recorded_adoption_scope: One accepted update is recorded; this diagnostic does not certify its gate or improvement. Its source world later failed.
limitations.timing_scope: Work/replay runtime excludes some persistence and cleanup; learner and callback clocks overlap. World supervisor elapsed includes other work. Partial-world measurements are censored.

conditions: All six fresh slots remain fixed; no surviving-old-arm combination, outcome-conditioned replacement, extension or retry.
Reviewed native actor and employee capability prerequisites, exact source/configuration provenance, unknown-usage failure rules and bounded owned cleanup must pass separately.
Six workers is the configured concurrency cap, not measured proof of stable six-world operation for 24 hours.
The current ten-hour campaign remains unchanged; this recommendation does not repair its failures or change acceptance.
The full new endpoint still requires three complete valid pairs; cap-stopped worlds remain incomplete.
recommendation.rationale: Two no-learning worlds completed in about 4.0–4.15 hours; 14 observed proposal epochs took 500–925 seconds, with only days 7/11 represented. A 24-hour cap permits more headroom than 10 hours while keeping a finite equal-arm limit. Thirty-six possible 1,800-second epochs allocate 18 hours before work and actor overhead, so 24 hours deliberately does not guarantee worst-case completion.

verification.scope: captured inventory, source hashes and raw/checkpoint/update/replay bindings; not original scientific or native lifecycle acceptance
